items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a guy that I go to Italy with... His name is Massimo Faro... sometimes this gentleman I was telling you about, my Italian son, Massimo, he gives a school over there in Italy for a couple of weeks, and he uses – sends for guys like me from here

ctx.x: Talk about a slew of trios that you’ve been involved with. Some of them we don’t know about, like Warren Bernhardt, Dave Holland.

That was because we all lived up in Woodstock at the time. It was convenient for us to do it. There wasn’t that many places to work, but whenever something come up, we could do it with the trio, because we were all there. Speaking of trios, I got a guy that I go to Italy with. I call him my Italian son. He loved Wynton Kelly. That’s how we got to meet. I think I met him through Bookie. Bookie went there first. He said - come back and said, “I met this little guy that loves Wynton. He wants you to come over…
